# Earnings Hub and Calendar. Earnings Hub is designed for investors to quickly stay on top of everything related to stock earnings, earnings calls, news, earnings reports, and quarterly calls. Features include: - Earnings Calendar - Listen to LIVE Earnings Calls - Listen to Past Earnings Calls - Analysts Expectations & Actuals - Quarterly Call Transcripts - AI Summaries of Call Transcripts - History of Revenue and EPS - Realtime News as it happens - Alerts of all of the above delivered via Text/Email or In-App Notifications Plus, EarningsHub provides free realtime stock quotes, charts, summaries of stock information and much more. * This app has not received enough ratings or reviews to display an overview. The developer, **Savvy Trader, Inc.**, indicated that the app’s privacy practices may include handling of data as described below. For more information, see the developer’s privacy policy . The developer has not yet indicated which accessibility features this app supports.
